title: Single-coordinate product noise
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability law $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite orthonormal basis of functions on $\Omega$ whose constant vector is one of its basis elements. For any natural number $n$, coordinate $i<n$, real $\rho$, and function $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$, the product noise operator with parameter $\rho$ at coordinate $i$ and parameter $1$ at every other coordinate equals the operator that leaves all other coordinates unchanged and applies noise with parameter $\rho$ at coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: probability law on the state space
orthonormal basis with a constant-one basis vector
real-valued function on the product space
